name: Mountain run power-hike 5x5
description: Five 5-minute fast power-hikes on a steep grade: the steep-uphill skill of mountain running. At 5.6 km/h this is the W1 walking-mode ceiling, not running.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Power-hike
steps.notes: RPE 7. Hands on thighs or poles-like arm drive, upright torso.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
